name: Underdraw
description: The construction lines left in: a dashed box under a solid corner.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M10 10 H90 V90 H10 Z; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-dasharray: 9 7; }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M10 10 H90 V90 H10 Z; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-dasharray: 9 7; }); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M10 40 V10 H40; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 9; stroke-linecap: round; }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M10 40 V10 H40; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 9; stroke-linecap: round; }); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
